```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## DAS Regions Visualization

This script generates genomic visualizations for multiple regions on **chr2**, including all 8 ATAC-seq BigWig tracks, MANE transcripts, and differentially accessible sites (DAS).

### Configuration

```{r config}
# ==============================================================================
# 0. Load Libraries
# ==============================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Gviz)
    library(rtracklayer)
    library(GenomicFeatures)
    library(org.Hs.eg.db)
    library(grid)
})

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Configuration
# ==============================================================================

# Paths
mane_gff_path <- "../data/MANE/MANE.GRCh38.v1.5.refseq_genomic.gff.gz"
bw_dir <- "../data/A172_GBM_ATAC_seq/"
das_bed_path <- "./outputs/ATAC_analysis/FINAL_bed_files_for_genome_browser_3_12_26/3_12_26_diff_accessible_peaks_FINAL_for_genomic_browser.bed"
output_dir <- "./outputs/DAS_regions_8_bigwigs_visualization/"

# Ensure output directory exists
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Regions of Interest
regions <- list(
    list(chrom = "chr2", start = 46849098, end = 46851200),
    list(chrom = "chr2", start = 47309762, end = 47311566),
    list(chrom = "chr2", start = 48420157, end = 48423896),
    list(chrom = "chr2", start = 47198713, end = 47199943),
    list(chrom = "chr2", start = 46812235, end = 46813356),
    list(chrom = "chr2", start = 47360933, end = 47361364)
)

# Genome Build
gen <- "hg38"
```

### Data Preparation (Static)

```{r data_prep}
# 1. Load Gene Annotation (TxDb)
if (!file.exists(mane_gff_path)) stop("MANE GFF file not found!")
message("Loading TxDb...")
txdb_mane <- makeTxDbFromGFF(mane_gff_path, format = "gff")
seqlevelsStyle(txdb_mane) <- "UCSC"

# 2. Define BigWig Files
bw_files <- c(
    "48hr_0.mRp.clN.bigWig", "48hr_10.mRp.clN.bigWig", "48hr_50.mRp.clN.bigWig", "48hr_100.mRp.clN.bigWig",
    "96hr_0.mRp.clN.bigWig", "96hr_10.mRp.clN.bigWig", "96hr_50.mRp.clN.bigWig", "96hr_100.mRp.clN.bigWig"
)

# 3. Load DAS Peaks (BED)
if (file.exists(das_bed_path)) {
    all_das_peaks_gr <- import(das_bed_path)
} else {
    stop("DAS BED file not found!")
}
```

### Visualization Loop

```{r visualization, fig.width=3, fig.height=4}
for (reg in regions) {
    chrom <- reg$chrom
    start_pos <- reg$start
    end_pos <- reg$end
    region_gr <- GRanges(chrom, IRanges(start_pos, end_pos))
    plot_title <- paste0(chrom, ":", start_pos, "-", end_pos)

    message(paste("Processing region:", plot_title))

    # 1. Genome Axis Track
    strack <- GenomeAxisTrack(scale = 0.1, labelPos = "above", showTitle = FALSE, col = "grey50", fontcolor = "grey50", fontsize = 7, lwd = 1)

    # 2. BigWig Data Tracks
    max_scores <- sapply(bw_files, function(f) {
        f_path <- file.path(bw_dir, paste0("GSM9825200_", f))
        if (file.exists(f_path)) {
            imported_bw <- import.bw(f_path, selection = region_gr)
            if (length(imported_bw) > 0) {
                return(max(score(imported_bw)))
            }
        }
        return(0)
    })
    global_ymax <- max(max_scores) * 1.05
    tick_interval <- if (global_ymax <= 3) 1 else 2

    bw_tracks <- lapply(bw_files, function(f) {
        f_path <- file.path(bw_dir, paste0("GSM9825200_", f))
        track_name <- gsub(".mRp.clN.bigWig", "", f)
        track_name <- gsub("_", " ", track_name)

        DataTrack(
            range = f_path, genome = gen, type = "histogram",
            chromosome = chrom, name = track_name,
            ylim = c(0, global_ymax),
            yTicksAt = seq(0, floor(global_ymax), by = tick_interval),
            col.histogram = "#8C8C8C", fill.histogram = "#8C8C8C",
            background.title = "transparent",
            background.panel = "transparent",
            col.frame = "transparent",
            col.title = "black", fontcolor.title = "black", fontsize.title = 7, cex.title = 1, fontface.title = 1,
            col.axis = "black", fontcolor.axis = "black", fontsize.axis = 7, cex.axis = 6 / 7, fontface.axis = 1,
            margin = 1, innerMargin = 0,
            showTitle = TRUE
        )
    })

    # 3. Gene Track (MANE Select)
    gene_track <- GeneRegionTrack(txdb_mane,
        genome = gen, chromosome = chrom, start = start_pos, end = end_pos,
        name = "MANE Select",
        transcriptAnnotation = "group",
        showId = TRUE,
        geneSymbols = TRUE,
        just.group = "left",
        stacking = "full",
        collapseTranscripts = FALSE,
        fill = "black", col = "black",
        fontcolor.group = "black", fontsize.group = 7, fontface.group = 1,
        background.title = "transparent",
        background.panel = "transparent",
        col.frame = "transparent",
        col.title = "black", fontsize.title = 7, cex.title = 6 / 7, fontface.title = 1,
        thinBoxFeature = c("UTR", "ncRNA", "utr", "3'UTR", "5'UTR"),
        col.line = "black",
        rotation.title = 0
    )

    # Map Symbols
    if (length(ranges(gene_track)) > 0) {
        gids <- gene(gene_track)
        clean_gids <- gsub("^GeneID:", "", gids)
        to_map <- unique(clean_gids[!is.na(clean_gids)])
        if (length(to_map) > 0) {
            sym_map <- tryCatch(
                {
                    suppressMessages(mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = to_map, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENTREZID", multiVals = "first"))
                },
                error = function(e) {
                    return(NULL)
                }
            )
            if (!is.null(sym_map)) {
                mapped_syms <- sym_map[clean_gids]
                mapped_syms[is.na(mapped_syms)] <- clean_gids[is.na(mapped_syms)]
                ranges(gene_track)$group <- mapped_syms
                ranges(gene_track)$symbol <- mapped_syms
            }
        }
    }

    # 4. DAS Peaks Track (BED)
    peaks_gr <- subsetByOverlaps(all_das_peaks_gr, region_gr)
    das_peaks_track <- NULL
    if (length(peaks_gr) > 0) {
        das_peaks_track <- AnnotationTrack(
            range = peaks_gr, genome = gen, chromosome = chrom,
            name = "DAS Peaks",
            shape = "box", fill = "#FF8400", col = "transparent",
            background.title = "transparent",
            background.panel = "transparent",
            col.frame = "transparent",
            col.title = "black", fontcolor.title = "black", fontsize.title = 7, cex.title = 6 / 7, fontface.title = 1,
            rotation.title = 0
        )
    }

    # Assemble Final List
    final_list <- c(list(strack), bw_tracks, list(gene_track))
    if (!is.null(das_peaks_track)) final_list <- c(final_list, list(das_peaks_track))

    # Define Sizes
    sizes_vec <- c(0.5, rep(1, 8), 0.5, 0.375)
    if (is.null(das_peaks_track)) sizes_vec <- sizes_vec[-length(sizes_vec)]

    # Save PDF
    pdf_name <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("DAS_region_", chrom, "_", start_pos, ".pdf"))
    pdf(pdf_name, width = 3, height = 4)
    plotTracks(final_list,
        from = start_pos, to = end_pos, chromosome = chrom,
        main = plot_title,
        fontsize = 7,
        cex.main = 7 / 12,
        margin = 2,
        sizes = sizes_vec, title.width = 1.1
    )
    dev.off()

    # Save PNG
    png_name <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("DAS_region_", chrom, "_", start_pos, ".png"))
    png(png_name, width = 3, height = 4, units = "in", res = 300)
    plotTracks(final_list,
        from = start_pos, to = end_pos, chromosome = chrom,
        main = plot_title,
        fontsize = 7,
        cex.main = 7 / 12,
        margin = 2,
        sizes = sizes_vec, title.width = 1.1
    )
    dev.off()

    # Display in Rmd
    plotTracks(final_list,
        from = start_pos, to = end_pos, chromosome = chrom,
        main = plot_title,
        fontsize = 7,
        cex.main = 7 / 12,
        margin = 2,
        sizes = sizes_vec, title.width = 1.1
    )
}
```
